title: Dharani Land Passbook (Telangana)
department: Revenue Department, Government of Telangana (Dharani Portal)
text: The Dharani portal is the integrated land records system of Telangana. The land passbook shows survey number, extent, land classification, owner name, and khata number. Services include registration of sale or gift deeds, mutation after registration, and download of passbook copies. Required documents for registration: Aadhaar cards of buyer and seller, previous link documents and passbook, NOC or clearance where the land is assigned or disputed, and passport photographs. Slot booking for registration is done on the Dharani portal, and both parties must appear at the sub-registrar office with originals. Any correction to owner name or extent requires a grievance on the portal with supporting survey records.
